01 / THE OPPORTUNITY

Make it work
harder for you.

WeTakeFWD provides digital marketing services for businesses that want a more connected path from discovery to meaningful enquiry. We begin with the audience, offer, service pages and response process before selecting the right mix of search, paid campaigns, content or automation.

The work can include search visibility, conversion-focused landing pages, Google and Meta campaign support, analytics, lead tracking and follow-up workflows. We measure the quality of conversations and opportunities, not only traffic or reach.

04 / GOOD TO KNOW

Before we
begin.

01What is included in digital marketing services?+

The right scope may include audience research, search visibility, campaigns, landing pages, content, analytics and enquiry follow-up. It depends on the business goal and current setup.

02Do you guarantee leads or rankings?+

No. Results depend on the offer, market, budget, competition, website and sales process. We define measurable work and improve based on evidence.

03Can digital marketing connect to our CRM?+

Yes. We can connect forms, campaign tracking and lead sources to a CRM so the team has useful context when following up.
